test_title: PYST 51: SSC CPO - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question:
Study the given graph and answer the following question. Number of boys and girls students in each section. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/067c88c015902792a643a5cc138e8df5e1133183f8e7ad4053957473af2f037a.png] 

The number of boy students in section B is approximately what percentage of the number of girl students in section E?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Number of boys in B = 30.

Number of girls in E = 55

According to the question:

⇒ 30/55 × 100 = 54.54 ≈ 55 %

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**
